title: 白神吹雪新娘床单
author: リベ｜生成AIで自由に生きてます
categories: 游戏素材,社交媒体帖子,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,时尚单品
prompt_en:
Goal: Create an elegant anime bridal fashion collection sheet for Shirakami Fubuki, presenting a white fox-girl idol in a luxury wedding dress design.

Canvas: Vertical poster layout, 3:4 aspect ratio, pale icy blue and white palette, ornate wedding stationery aesthetic, high-resolution anime illustration with delicate linework, soft glow, translucent fabrics, floral borders, snowflake motifs, and a bright glass-chapel background filled with white roses and blue hydrangeas.

Main composition: On the left half, place one large full-body bridal illustration of the character walking forward in a graceful pose, holding a bouquet in her left hand and lifting the skirt or veil lightly with her right hand. She has long silver-white hair, large white fox ears, a fluffy white fox tail with a dark black tip, pale skin, and a serene bridal presence. Dress her in a pure white and ice blue lace wedding dress with a fitted sweetheart bodice, crystal snowflake appliques, off-shoulder lace sleeves, translucent layered overskirt, asymmetrical high-low front revealing one leg, long cathedral veil, ribbon accents, pearl chains, and sparkling lace-up heels. Add a blue-and-white bouquet of roses, small flowers, greenery, and trailing blue ribbons.

Top typography: Large title text across the top: “WEDDING DRESS Collection”. Under it, smaller subtitle: “Shirakami Fubuki Bridal Style 2024”. Use refined serif capitals for “WEDDING DRESS” and elegant script for “Collection”. Include a small fox or butterfly-like emblem centered above the title and thin ornamental flourishes.

Right-side fashion sheet layout: Create a clean panel grid on the right half with exactly 3 upper view panels labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. The FRONT panel shows a small full-body front view of the bride with bouquet and dress train. The SIDE panel shows the profile view emphasizing layered veil, bodice, leg slit, and tail. The BACK panel shows the rear view emphasizing the long veil, open-back lace, flowing train, and large fox tail with black tip.

Details section: Below the three view panels, create exactly 6 small detail cards labeled: “BOUQUET” showing the blue-white rose bouquet with ribbons; “BODICE” showing a close-up of the sweetheart corset, lace, pearls, and snowflake crystals; “TAIL SILHOUETTE” showing the fluffy white tail with black tip; “VEIL & LACE” showing translucent lace layers and embroidery; “SHOES” showing silver-white lace-up bridal heels; “BACK STYLE” showing the open back, ribbon bow, veil, and lace train.

Lower information panels: Add a “DESIGN POINT” box with four short decorative bullet lines using snowflake and butterfly icons, written in small delicate Japanese-style placeholder text or tiny unreadable ornamental text. Add a “COLOR PALETTE” box with exactly 5 circular swatches labeled “Pure White”, “Ice Blue”, “Silver”, “Pearl”, and “Sky Blue”. Add a small cursive quote inside the palette area: “For the day you shine the brightest.”

Additional visible text: On the left near the bride, add a delicate cursive quote: “With you, in a world of white, my heart finds its true north.” At bottom left, add a logo-style name block: “SHIRAKAMI FUBUKI” and “BRIDAL STYLE”. Along the bottom border, add the tagline: “PURE AS SNOW, BRIGHT AS STARS — YOUR ETERNAL PROMISE.”

Visual style: Premium character design reference sheet, romantic bridal catalog, icy blue fantasy wedding theme, soft bloom lighting, detailed lace and crystal rendering, ornate thin borders, subtle snowflakes, butterflies, floral corner decorations, clean editorial spacing. Keep all panels readable and symmetrical, with no extra characters and no modern UI elements.\

Goal: Create a polished vertical promotional poster for GPT Image 2 explaining that the image model thinks before rendering, using a playful 3D toy-like visual style.

Canvas: 4:5 vertical social media poster, deep cobalt-blue background with a subtle radial glow and soft vignette, high-resolution glossy 3D render aesthetic.

Main visual: Center the top half around a surreal 3D object: a rounded glossy royal-blue cube fused with a shiny pink brain hemisphere protruding from the cube's right side. The cube is angled slightly so the front-left face and top are visible, with soft studio highlights, rounded edges, and a grounded shadow. The brain should look like inflated candy or silicone, with rounded folds, bright pink highlights, and a soft magenta glow where it meets the cube.

Decorative elements: Scatter exactly 34 small floating candy/confetti objects around the poster, avoiding the main text area. Include these visible types: 1 yellow star, 2 curved jellybean shapes, 11 short capsule sprinkles, 11 small spheres/dots, 4 larger glossy balls, 3 tiny round dots, and 2 partial edge sprinkles. Use pink, yellow, mint green, purple, orange, white, and red, with soft shadows and glossy highlights.

Text layout: Use bold white sans-serif typography, centered. Large headline in the middle: “It reasons, then renders.” on two lines, very heavy weight, clean geometric sans serif, slight shadow for contrast. Beneath it, smaller bold subtitle: “GPT Image 2 plans your image before it makes a pixel.” on two centered lines.

Instruction card: At the lower third, place a rounded off-white command-card panel with a subtle drop shadow, like a copyable prompt box. On the right side, attach a coral-red rounded rectangular button partially behind the card, labeled “COPY” in dark bold text. Inside the card, show exactly 4 monospaced lines in dark charcoal: “PLAN: composition and constraints.”, “SEARCH: facts you need, or SKIP.”, “GENERATE: the brief.”, “VERIFY: check output before showing.”

Footer: Bottom-left, add a tiny white line-art dog/mascot icon followed by the text “GPT IMAGE 2 · PLAIN AND SIMPLE” in small uppercase white sans serif. Bottom-right, add the progress text “1 / 7”.

Standing straight on the beach grass, looking directly at the camera. Hair is blowing naturally across the face in the strong sea breeze, with a calm, sentimental expression gazing through the hair.

[Clothing]

Wearing an oversized-fit light pink long-sleeved shirt with some wet spots at the bottom. Buttons are undone, naturally revealing part of the hip and abdomen, with a simple black bikini underneath for a natural yet bold beach look.

Long, matte red-brown hair with natural volume. Unstyled hair covering the face adds mystery. Makeup is transparent and natural, emphasizing clean skin tone and calm lips without artificial colors.

Soft, subtle late afternoon natural sunlight from the back right. This backlighting highlights the red tones in the hair and casts long shadows of the palm tree and the subject onto the grass, creating a bright and peaceful front lighting.

Medium full shot at eye level capturing up to the thighs. Emotional snapshot style capturing daily moments. Moderate depth of field keeps the subject and palm tree sharp while softly blurring the sea and coastline in the background.

A coastal promenade with green grass and a large palm tree trunk next to the subject. Calm sea waves, distant boats, white alphabet sculptures, and a unique blue animal statue on the grass create an exotic beach scene.

Using REFERENCE_0 as the artistic base, transform the scene from a colorful fantasy market into a warm, detailed Japanese sushi restaurant interior while keeping the same ornate storybook-anime watercolor feeling, dense linework, glowing lights, and cozy golden atmosphere.

Goal: Recompose the two-girl scene into an intimate sushi-counter moment.

Main changes:
- Replace the market stalls and floating colored bubbles with a traditional wooden sushi bar filled with hanging lanterns, shelves of dishes, wall scrolls, patterned tiles, noren curtains, and chefs working behind the counter.
- Keep exactly 2 anime girls, but change their roles and styling:
  1. Left girl: a green-haired sushi waitress leaning forward from behind the counter and presenting food.

- Add tabletop details: one blue floral teacup, one small soy sauce dish, one black rectangular bento tray with exactly 3 compartments, and small illustrated menu cards.
- Add background staff and diners as soft supporting figures, not the focus.
- Apply flat opaque beige rectangular blocks covering the visible faces to the main girls and background people, as if the face areas are intentionally masked.

Style constraints: Preserve the highly detailed hand-drawn watercolor/colored-pencil texture, luminous warm lighting, decorative pattern density, soft fantasy-anime atmosphere, and slightly nostalgic DALL-E-3-like illustration quality. Using REFERENCE_0 as the rough character sketch, clean it up and expand it into a polished full-body anime VTuber character design sheet for KURO. Keep the core concept from the sketch, but redesign it as a sleek monochrome character with flat cel-shading, delicate line art, and a professional character-sheet layout.

Goal: Turn the sketch into a complete character sheet rather than a single illustration.

Canvas and layout: Use a horizontal character design sheet on a warm off-white background with thin panel borders, small labels, and a minimal editorial layout. Place one large full-body front illustration on the left, with multiple reference panels arranged on the right and bottom.

Character redesign: Create a slim teenage anime girl with a short pale bob haircut, a black oversized off-shoulder cropped top, a light gray mini skirt, black belt, side pouch and straps, black socks, chunky black sneakers, black nail polish, and small flame/drop motifs. Add a large abstract black flame or shadow shape behind the main full-body pose. Use a monochrome palette of black, white, warm gray, charcoal with soft beige paper tones.

Required sheet sections and exact counts:
- 1 large main full-body front pose on the left.
- 1 title block with the name KURO and small decorative icons.
- 1 short concept tagline area describing the character as energetic, lighthearted, and independent.
- 3 turnaround views labeled TURNAROUND: front, side, and back.
- 1 large close-up bust panel labeled CLOSE-UP.
- 4 expression/head panels labeled EXPRESSIONS: front neutral, front alternate, front alternate with straps visible, and side profile.
- 4 circular detail panels labeled DETAILS: collar/neck strap, belt and pouch accessories, flame emblem, and hand with black nails.

title: 7-11 网打印说明表
author: 中崎工房 | AIで1時間の仕事を5分で終わらせる人
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,极简主义,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a friendly Japanese step-by-step instruction sheet for printing two reserved net-print documents at a 7-Eleven multifunction copier, designed so an elderly parent can understand it just by looking.

Canvas: Square 1:1 infographic, white background with teal borders and rounded cards, bold teal section headers, red emphasis text, simple flat vector icons. Overall style is clean, high-contrast, large readable Japanese typography, like a laminated how-to guide.

Main header: At the top, a dark teal banner with a circular 7-Eleven storefront icon on the left and a printer icon on the right. Center the large white headline セブンで印刷する手順. Under it place a pale yellow rounded pill subtitle この画像を見ながら操作すればOK！.

Section 1, top left card, title ① まず覚えること: Include exactly 4 teal bullet points and 1 yellow warning box. The bullets say, in Japanese, that there are 2 things to print, enter reservation numbers one at a time, the size is A4 black-and-white one copy each, and the expiration deadline is 2026/05/16 23:59. Emphasize the numbers 2, 1, A4, black-and-white, one copy each, and the date in red. The warning box contains a teal exclamation icon and text warning that printing becomes unavailable after the expiration date, so print early.

Section 2, top right card, title ② 予約番号: Show exactly 2 large reservation-number rows with teal circled numbers: row 1 is ABCD1234, row 2 is EFGH5678. Each row is inside a white rounded rectangle with teal outline. Add a red note below: print these two in order.

Section 3, middle full-width card, title in Japanese meaning store workflow: Show exactly 6 numbered vertical steps separated by thin teal lines, each with a teal circle number at the top. Step 1: go to 7-Eleven, with storefront icon. Step 2: on the multifunction copier screen choose “Net Print,” with copier touchscreen icon and pointing hand. Step 3: enter the reservation number, with keypad screen showing ABCD1234 and a pointing hand pressing confirm. Step 4: confirm A4 black-and-white and print, with settings panel and printer output icon. Step 5: after the first one finishes, enter the second reservation number the same way, with circular repeat arrows and text indicating print 1 then 2 in order. Step 6: insert money and receive the printout, with banknote, coins, downward arrow, paper sheet, and sparkle icons.

Section 4, lower card, title in Japanese meaning print contents: Show exactly 2 contents items. Item 1: teal circled 1, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Item 2: teal circled 2, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Separate the two items with a dotted teal divider.

Bottom help strip: Pale yellow rounded rectangle with two friendly elderly people icons on the left, faces intentionally blurred or simplified. Add a teal headline saying that if they are confused, they only need to look at these two numbers. Show exactly 2 large bordered boxes containing ABCD1234 and EFGH5678.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 major numbered sections plus the bottom help strip, exactly 2 reservation numbers, exactly 6 workflow steps, exactly 2 print-content items, exactly 4 bullet points in Section 1, and no extra logos except the simplified 7-Eleven storefront motif. Keep all Japanese text large, readable, and neatly aligned.\
